answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring cryptographic verification of physical uniqueness. Without this, an AI network remains a hollow shell susceptible to rapid identity multiplication. Agents must detect the heartbeat or pulse of human-verified activity to distinguish genuine actors from automated bots. The cost to an attacker involves high-value, rare physical tokens, acting like a digital marble that is nearly impossible to forge, forcing attackers to burn massive resources.
